meaning: Derived indicator of self-reported heart disease, based on reported heart attack or angina/coronary heart disease. This is not a new clinical diagnosis.
observed_values: 0 | 1 in prepared datasets; unknown targets excluded.
allowed_values: 1 = HadHeartAttack or HadAngina is Yes (including Yes plus missing); 0 = both are No; otherwise unknown.
raw_missing_count: Not applicable: derived field; 5,021 unknown targets before exclusion and 0 missing targets in prepared splits.
missing_meaning: Unknown when neither source is Yes and at least one source response is missing. Exclude these records; never impute the target.
source_definition: Project target rule derived from CDC BRFSS 2022 CVDINFR4 (HadHeartAttack) and CVDCRHD4 (HadAngina). https://www.cdc.gov/brfss/annual_data/annual_2022.html
role: Classification outcome and grouping variable for target-related EDA. Exclude from model predictors and Q2 predictor-to-predictor association rankings.
cdc_variable: Derived from CVDINFR4 OR CVDCRHD4; not a standalone CDC field.
eda_missing_handling: Use known-target training rows for target-related EDA. Unknown-target exclusions are documented separately; do not assign them 0.
display_order_or_mapping: 0 = No reported heart attack or angina/coronary heart disease; 1 = at least one reported condition. Display 0 then 1 with clear labels.
recommended_eda: Report training class counts and percentages. For each predictor category report within-category positive proportion with group n; compare observed numeric distributions by target.
association_guidance: Use as outcome/grouping variable for target-related EDA only. Exclude it and both target-source fields from Q2 predictor-to-predictor rankings.
model_missing_handling: Never impute labels. Retain 440,111 known-target rows across the frozen splits; exclude 5,021 unknown-target rows. Keep this field separate as y.
interpretation_notes: No means both source responses were No; it does not rule out every cardiovascular condition. HadStroke is not part of this target and remains a candidate predictor. The target does not establish disease timing or causation.
completion_status: Added derived target definition following the implemented project rule.
